summary: This document outlines the multi-slice implementation strategy for integrating ClankerLog as a global managed hook for OpenClaw.
responsibilities: Define the global installation path for OpenClaw hooks (~/.openclaw/hooks/clankerlog/).
Specify the event-driven architecture for monitoring 'message:sent' without logging sensitive content.
Categorize the integration into six implementation slices ranging from contract probing to manual verification.
Establish privacy and security constraints, explicitly prohibiting the collection of prompts, transcripts, or code diffs.
